title: The Hunt（1957.141）
holder: 克利夫兰美术馆（藏品号 1957.141）
one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「300–100 BCE」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: China, Warring States period (475–221 BCE) to Western Han dynasty (206 BCE–8 CE)
Gift of Homer H. Tielke Jr., in honor of the fortieth wedding anniversary of Mr. and Mrs. Homer H. Tielke Sr.

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → spring-autumn-warring；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: Vassar College. Chinese Painting: Seventy-Fifth Anniversary Exhibition May 22 to June 10, 1940. Poughkeepsie, NY: The Gallery, 1940.（Mentioned: cat. nos. 1, 2, pl. 1）
The Cleveland Museum of Art. The Cleveland Museum of Art Handbook. Cleveland, OH: The Cleveland Museum of Art, 1958.（Mentioned and Reproduced: cat. no. 812）
Lee, Sherman E. "Early Chinese Painted Shells with Hunting Scenes." Archives of the Chinese Art Society of America 11 (1957): 69–75.（Mentioned: pp. 69–75; Reproduced: p. 71, figs. 1a, 2a, 3a）
Goepper, Roger. 1000 Jahre chinesische Malerei. München: Haus der Kunst, 1959.（Mentioned: cat. no. 1）
Trubner, Henry. Arts of the Han Dynasty. New York: Chinese Art Society of America, Asia House, 1961.（Mentioned: cat. no. 85）
**馆方记录另有 5 条著录未在此列出。**

dating.text: 馆方给出了年代，**但未在公开记录中说明这个年代依据什么**——是铭文、器形序列、共出器物还是风格比对，无从得知。本库的断代十档因此无法填写：**填任何一档都是替馆方作了它没作的声明。**

provenance.text: Samuel Hubert Minkenhof [1879–1956], Amsterdam, Netherlands, and New York, NY
(C.T. Loo 盧芹齋 [1880–1957], Paris, France, and New York, NY, purchased with funds from Homer H. Tielke Jr. [1918–2004] for gift to the Cleveland Museum of Art)
The Cleveland Museum of Art, Cleveland, OH
以上递藏链照录自馆方档案。**本库未独立核实其中任一环节**；经手人身份、交易性质与时间点均以馆方记录为准，本库不据此判定流散性质。

reception.title: China through the Magnifying Glass: Masterpieces in Miniature and Detail

reception.text: 展览史照录自馆方档案，**本库未核对展览图录原件**；仅现行档案（current）部分，馆方标为 legacy 的旧记录未收。
